target_customer: Private fund managers (including crypto and institutional funds) and their investors
problem: Fund subscription paperwork, data rooms and investor communication run on PDFs and email. Nova put them into one digital platform.
product_category: Investor management software for private funds

founders.name: Pradyuman Vig
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch says he was 26 at the time of writing in 2023 context and started Nova in Austin; the YC page says Dallas. The age refers to an unclear date so it is not recorded.

technical_complexity.rationale: Document workflow, e-signature and permissions software, which is standard B2B SaaS engineering with compliance care.

defensibility.rationale: Fund managers rarely switch tools mid raise, but features were copyable by larger fund admin vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AngelList bought Nova in June 2023 and rebranded the subscriptions product as AngelList Transact.

market_need_then: Fund subscription documents were paper and PDF heavy, and by 2023 Nova reported more than 10,000 investors with Nova identities. No 2018 spend data was found.

branding.domain_note: novahq.com, with an HQ suffix rather than nova.com.

rebrands.to: AngelList Transact and AngelList Data Room

brand_strength.rationale: A generic name shared with other fintechs (Nova Credit), no brand press found, and it was retired into AngelList products.

outcome_analysis: Nova raised about 2 million dollars after YC and a 7 million dollar Series A in July 2022, signed institutional customers such as Van Eck and Pantera, and was bought by AngelList in June 2023 for undisclosed terms. The Series A was reported to have preempted a planned round, which suggests investor demand. The outcome is an acquisition that folded the product into a larger platform, with no price known.
notes: Both rounds come from TechCrunch only, and I could not find a second outlet; treat the amounts as single-source. The seed date is not stated. The YC page says Dallas while TechCrunch says Austin and CB Insights says Brooklyn. A dated 2018 competitor search returned only current vendor pages, so the list is empty. Nova Credit is a different company.
